front.title: Ontology-based Semantic Interaction for Internet of Agents

abstract.t: This document specifies an ontology-based semantic profile for expressing capabilities, intents, tasks, and domain context in agent interactions. It defines a core vocabulary, a JSON-LD serialization profile, and processing rules for determining semantic compatibility using explicit identifiers, applicable constraints, and accepted alignment artifacts. It distinguishes descriptive metadata and candidate mapping suggestions from semantic values used in decisions. The profile can be carried by existing discovery and interaction mechanisms; it does not define an authorization, transport, session, or directory synchronization protocol. Deterministic processing is limited to the declared profile, versions, constraints, and accepted mappings, and does not imply automatic interpretation of arbitrary natural-language content.
